exact_sparse_identity: sum_j A_{ij}^2 - 2 * <(A Z)_i, z_i> + z_i * (Z^T Z) * z_i^T
binary_special_case: d_i - 2 * <(A Z)_i, z_i> + z_i * (Z^T Z) * z_i^T

terms.term_1_degree: sum_j A_{ij}^2 (reduces to d_i = sum_j A_{ij} for binary adjacency)
terms.term_2_cross: cross_i = sum_k (A Z)_{ik} Z_{ik} = <(A Z)_i, z_i>
terms.term_3_gram: z_i * (Z^T Z) * z_i^T = ((Z * G) * Z)_{i,:} where G = Z^T Z

generality.weighted: Algebraically exact using sum_j A_{ij}^2 and weighted sparse aggregation
